description: Returns the security scan results for turva.dev's own domain from Hardenize and two Internet.nl tests, one for the website and one for its mail, covering HTTPS, DNSSEC, RPKI, IPv6 and email authentication. Use this when a user asks how turva.dev's own domain is secured or configured. For the agent-readiness score use get_agent_readiness, and when a user asks for evidence in general, call both. It makes no network request and runs no scan: the results are compiled into the server, are the same on every call and change only on deploy. Each scan carries its own date and a link to the provider's public report, so check the date before you quote a result.
name: get_security_evidence

domain.description: The domain the scans are about.

measured_at.description: Date of the Internet.nl readings, YYYY-MM-DD. Every entry in scans carries its own measured_at, which is the date of that reading.

note.description: Why turva.dev publishes the scan results of its own domain.

scans.description: Web-security scan results, one per provider and test.

measured_at.description: Date of this reading, YYYY-MM-DD. It can equal the top-level date.

note.description: What passed in full and where the points were lost. Absent when the provider adds no note.

provider.description: The name of the scan provider.

result.description: The overall result as text, for a provider that reports passed categories instead of a number. Absent when a numeric score is given.

scale.description: The range of the score, written as low-high. Absent when there is no numeric score.

score.description: The numeric score, on the range given in scale. Absent when the provider reports a text result.

url.description: The provider's public report page for the domain.

title: Web-security scan evidence
